label: Every world sees itself, yet two possibilities of one world need not see each other
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed: every world accesses itself, and some world accesses two worlds of which the first does not access the second. Replacement account: metaphysical possibility is relative and not transitive, motivated by arguments from series of small changes in a thing's origin or constitution; the logic of metaphysical modality is then T rather than S5. Stronger than the negation of the Euclidean premise by the reflexivity conjunct.
